senses.gloss: m. (עָבָה) dense, large-sized, opp. מידק, v. דָּקק.
units: <cite ref="Arakhin 25a:25">Arakh. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>לא מְעֻבֶּה וכ׳</he> neither too densely, nor too sparsely sown.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 4:9">Succ. IV, 9</cite> (<cite ref="Sukkah 48b:1">48ᵇ</cite>); a. e.—Pl. <he>מְעוּבִּין</he>.

<cite ref="Pesachim 64b:8">Pes. 64ᵇ</cite> <he>והיו קוראין אותו פסח מ׳</he> (not <he>אותן</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 9; Ms. M. <he>מְנוּיִן</he>, v. <cite ref="M01772"><he>מָנָה</he></cite>) and they called it the Passover of the crowded, v. <cite ref="M02121"><he>מָעַךְ</he></cite>.
